dek: What is actually selling and spreading on TikTok and Instagram this fall, each with the dated report behind it.

boards.dek: Chart-toppers on US TikTok Shop this fall, by Kalodata's monthly sales counts.

boards.title: Kitchen and home
boards.dek: A viral frozen-drink machine and one Instagram decor find.

items.name: Smooth & Clear Body Care Set
items.why: A Korean body-care kit for rough, bumpy skin that was the top-grossing product on US TikTok Shop in September 2026, with about 150,000 sets sold that month per Kalodata. FastMoss also ranks it first for the third quarter, at roughly $9.6 million in sales.
items.ebay: medicube smooth clear body care set

trend.note: The No. 1 product by revenue on US TikTok Shop in September 2026 and across Q3.

items.name: Sensory Wall Toddler Mirror, Large 1 Bubble
items.why: A convex bubble mirror sold as a kids' sensory toy that stylists are hanging as wall decor; Apartment Therapy found it for about $68 after an interior stylist's video took off on Instagram.

trend.note: Instagram decorators are hanging this kids' convex mirror as a sculptural wall mirror.

items.name: The Dreamer Blanket
items.why: A plush throw blanket. Net Influencer, using Kalodata figures, ranked it the No. 2 product on US TikTok Shop in September 2026 with $2.56 million in sales, after also placing second in August.

trend.note: A top-two TikTok Shop product in both August and September 2026.

items.name: SLUSHi Professional Frozen Drink Maker (FS301)
items.why: An 88 oz countertop slushie and frozen-drink machine. Net Influencer ranked it the No. 4 product on US TikTok Shop in August 2026, with $2.1 million from about 6,440 units (Kalodata data).

trend.note: No. 4 on US TikTok Shop by revenue in August 2026.

items.name: DELTA 3 Classic Portable Power Station (1024Wh)
items.why: A 1024Wh battery power station for outages and camping. Net Influencer ranked it No. 8 on US TikTok Shop in September 2026, with $1.59 million from 3,980 units at an average of about $399.

trend.note: No. 8 on US TikTok Shop by revenue in September 2026.

items.name: Nex Playground Active Play System
items.why: A motion-camera game console for active family play, no controllers. TikTok's newsroom and Modern Retail both report it sold more than 25,000 units on TikTok Shop last year, and TikTok names it a gaming standout for this holiday season.

trend.note: Named by TikTok as a holiday 2026 gaming standout after 25,000-plus TikTok Shop units last year.

items.name: Beachwaver Pro Rotating Curling Iron
items.why: Beachwaver's flagship rotating curling iron. Modern Retail reports the brand sold more than 1.1 million units on US TikTok Shop in one year.

trend.note: The brand sold 1.1 million-plus units on TikTok Shop in a year.

items.name: Express Your e.l.f. 24-Day Advent Calendar
items.why: e.l.f.'s 2026 makeup and skincare advent calendar. Modern Retail reports it had sold more than 2,500 units on TikTok Shop by Oct. 20, early in the holiday season.

trend.note: 2,500-plus units sold on TikTok Shop by late October.

items.name: You Know You Love Me Collector's Set
items.why: A holiday makeup set with two clay palettes, two mascaras and Maracuja Juicy Lip products. Modern Retail reports it has sold more than 1,700 units on TikTok Shop, where Tarte has sold 8.6 million units since 2023.
items.ebay: tarte you know you love me set

trend.note: 1,700-plus units sold on TikTok Shop this season.

items.name: Honey Oud Eau de Parfum
items.why: A low-priced unisex honey-and-oud perfume. Net Influencer ranked it No. 5 on US TikTok Shop in September 2026, with $1.73 million from 87,520 units at about $19.79, and fifth in August too.

trend.note: A top-five TikTok Shop product in both August and September 2026.

items.name: Cordless Pressure Washer Gun
items.why: A battery handheld pressure washer for cars, decks and driveways. Net Influencer ranked it No. 6 on US TikTok Shop in September 2026 ($1.67 million) and No. 3 in August (about 71,000 units at roughly $32).

trend.note: A top-six TikTok Shop product in August and September 2026.
